# Ankur Gupta

> Backend Developer. The backend behind a better product.

Ankur Gupta is a Computer Science student at the National Institute of Technology Hamirpur focused on backend development, full-stack applications, and building reliable software through practical projects.

## Projects
- [FATGS](https://ankurgupta.dev/work/fatgs): Faculty Allocation and Timetable Generation System designed to organize academic scheduling requirements involving faculty, classes, subjects, rooms, and weekly time slots.
- [TT_TRACKER](https://ankurgupta.dev/work/tt_tracker): Academic Timetable Tracking and Management System designed to provide class-wise and faculty-wise timetable views and support schedule changes, cancellations, and room availability checks.
- [PRISMS](https://ankurgupta.dev/work/prisms): PhD Research & Institutional Scholars Management System supporting the lifecycle of PhD scholars, beginning with a thesis submission module.
